name: Kordyne
bio: Kordyne was not created on purpose – it was the result of a strange and dangerous experiment. A powerful mage-lord drew unthinkable power from half a dozen ley lines at once… then simply let the power go. The explosion destroyed everything for a kilometer around. When the dust settled, Kordyne was the only thing left standing.
subtitle: The Astral Nexus
